schema_note: Alternate foundation system to S-02 (spread footing) -- used if soil bearing capacity <= 10 ton/sqm per S-01 notes. Footing marks here are pile-count based (F3=3-pile cap, F4=4-pile cap, F6=6-pile cap), confirmed by detail sheets S-11 ('ขยายฐานราก F4,F6') and S-12 ('ขยายฐานราก F3'). Same grid as S-02/S-04/S-05. Same footing/column element separation convention as S-02 (see that file's schema_note).
warnings: Same irregular footprint as S-02 -- rows B/A only have columns 2-3.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'footing_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 3 footing-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
